'''2001 Madrid tournament (Nacho's Bar)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Nacho's Bar, Madrid, Spain on 2001. [[Heraclio Sanchez]] won it. It is known from Heraclio Sanchez's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2951">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-10-ithor-madrid-08-sept-01d2951/ ithor-madrid-08-sept-01], DeckTech (Heraclio "Morgoth" Sanchez, 10 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-10-ithor-madrid-08-sept-01d2951/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 2001
* '''Site:''' Nacho's Bar, Madrid, Spain
* '''Winner:''' [[Heraclio Sanchez]]
